title: Dual anti-inflammatory effects of curcumin and berberine on acetaminophen-induced liver injury in mice by inhibiting NF-kappaB activation via PI3K/AKT and PPARgamma signaling pathways.
authors: Zhai, Fengguo; Wang, Jiale; Wan, Xueying; Liu, Yue; Mao, Xu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄素与小檗碱联合用药对APAP肝损伤的抗炎作用，涉及NF-kappaB通路和分子对接，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Acetaminophen (APAP) overdose is still a leading cause of drug-induced liver injury (DILI), accompanied with severe inflammatory response. However, the therapy for APAP-induced DILI is rather limited. The combined application of natural products to treat DILI induced by APAP may be a new direction of the research. This study was conducted to evaluate the dual anti-inflammatory activity of curcumin (CUR) combined with berberine (BBR) against APAP-mediated DILI. Network pharmacology found that PI3K-Akt and PPAR signaling pathways were primarily involved in anti-DILI of the combination of CUR and BBR. APAP injection enhanced the levels of ALT, AST, IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha in mice, while such phenomenon was significantly reversed by the cotreatment of CUR and BBR, which was more effective than either single treatment. The increase of p-NF-kappaB and p-IKKalpha/beta protein expression and the decrease of p-PI3K, p-AKT, and PPARgamma protein expression in APAP-treated mice were markedly inhibited by the coadministration of CUR and BBR. Molecular docking further demonstrated that both CUR and BBR could stably bind to PI3K, AKT, and PPARgamma protein. In conclusion, the combination of CUR and BBR more effectively protected liver from APAP-triggered DILI than individual treatment. The mechanism is to alleviate hepatic inflammation by inhibiting NF-kappaB activation, which is possibly mediated by PI3K/Akt and PPARgamma signaling pathways.
abstract_zh: 对乙酰氨基酚（APAP）过量仍是药物性肝损伤（DILI）的主要原因之一，并伴有严重的炎症反应。然而，针对APAP诱导的DILI的治疗方法相当有限。联合应用天然产物治疗APAP诱导的DILI可能是一个新的研究方向。本研究旨在评估姜黄素（CUR）联合小檗碱（BBR）对APAP介导的DILI的双重抗炎活性。网络药理学发现，PI3K-Akt和PPAR信号通路主要参与CUR与BBR联合抗DILI的作用。APAP注射增强了小鼠体内ALT、AST、IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α的水平，而CUR和BBR的联合处理显著逆转了这一现象，且效果优于任一单独处理。APAP处理小鼠中p-NF-κB和p-IKKα/β蛋白表达的增加以及p-PI3K、p-AKT和PPARγ蛋白表达的减少，均被CUR和BBR的联合给药显著抑制。分子对接进一步证明，CUR和BBR均能稳定结合PI3K、AKT和PPARγ蛋白。总之，CUR与BBR联合使用比单独治疗更有效地保护肝脏免受APAP触发的DILI。其机制是通过抑制NF-κB激活来减轻肝脏炎症，这可能由PI3K/Akt和PPARγ信号通路介导。
